propositions: Code review must compile and execute DiscoveryStagePlan units from immutable CriteriaSnapshot instead of combining workflow-authored criteria with unconditional project fan-in and packaged-only overlay selection.

Code review must respect effective disables, retunes, project applicability rules, and explicit dollar budgets; omitting a criterion must be recorded internally without adding trace fields to the review response.
When one local criterion call fails, code review must retain earlier successes and continue independent criteria; blocking-capable missing coverage yields INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists.
Positive authored usd_budget values must be enforced and shed units recorded before calls; zero budget must be rejected by workflow validation; omitted budgets remain uncapped.

Code review must preserve authored YAML topology, base-reviewer summary/recommendations, per-overlay context overrides, sequential scheduling, and absence of checkpoints while executing through the shared kernel.
Shadow contract tests must use one observed call set, report no differences outside the approved delta allowlist, and keep code-review response and status schemas narrow and backward-compatible.
